title: Allow manually sending all persistent notifications to the history
line: Every notification that stays on screen until you act on it now has a Minimize button that tucks it into the notification history.
explanation: Since Plasma 6.4 a notification popup gets a Minimize button only when it is both persistent (no timeout) and resident, so ordinary persistent notifications, like a Chrome extension's code review alerts, could only be closed, never set aside. They stayed on top of windows until the user acted on them. The change makes every persistent notification minimizable; the tray's bell and its 'N active notifications' tooltip now count any minimized notification, not only resident ones, so it stays visible in the panel until it's handled or restored.

commits.message:
notifications: allow minimizing every persistent notification

Only resident notifications without a timeout could be minimized to the
history, so other notifications that stay on screen until acted upon had
to be closed to get them out of the way. Allow it for all of them.

BUG: 503514

patches.diff:
From f24d9fb9ae8c48731aed1728825371fb7c0689e1 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 17:58:26 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] notifications: allow minimizing every persistent notification

Only resident notifications without a timeout could be minimized to the
history, so other notifications that stay on screen until acted upon had
to be closed to get them out of the way. Allow it for all of them.

BUG: 503514
---
 libnotificationmanager/abstractnotificationsmodel.cpp | 2 +-
 libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp              | 2 +-
 libnotificationmanager/notifications.h                | 2 +-
 3 files changed, 3 insertions(+), 3 deletions(-)

diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/abstractnotificationsmodel.cpp b/libnotificationmanager/abstractnotificationsmodel.cpp
index 2bfd15d12f..d5e35507b0 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/abstractnotificationsmodel.cpp
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/abstractnotificationsmodel.cpp
@@ -458,7 +458,7 @@ QVariant AbstractNotificationsModel::data(const QModelIndex &index, int role) co
     case Notifications::DismissedRole:
         return notification.dismissed();
     case Notifications::DismissableRole:
-        return notification.resident() && notification.timeout() == 0;
+        return notification.timeout() == 0;
     }
 
     return {};
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp b/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp
index baa61cecc9..494a884d81 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/notifications.cpp
@@ -321,7 +321,7 @@ void Notifications::Private::updateCount()
             }
         }
 
-        if (!isExpired && idx.data(Notifications::ResidentRole).toBool() && idx.data(Notifications::DismissedRole).toBool()) {
+        if (!isExpired && idx.data(Notifications::TypeRole).toInt() == Notifications::NotificationType && idx.data(Notifications::DismissedRole).toBool()) {
             ++dismissedResident;
         }
 
diff --git a/libnotificationmanager/notifications.h b/libnotificationmanager/notifications.h
index 25b62c1ea0..a533bc0795 100644
--- a/libnotificationmanager/notifications.h
+++ b/libnotificationmanager/notifications.h
@@ -221,7 +221,7 @@ class NOTIFICATIONMANAGER_EXPORT Notifications : public QSortFilterProxyModel, p
     Q_PROPERTY(int unreadNotificationsCount READ unreadNotificationsCount NOTIFY unreadNotificationsCountChanged)
 
     /**
-     * The number of resident notifications that have been dismissed
+     * The number of persistent notifications that have been dismissed
      *
      * This can be used to show that there is an active notification in the history
      *
--

Same notification with the fix: a Minimize button next to Close
Pure master: the popup keeps covering the screen; it's in the history but can only be closed
After Minimize: the popup is gone, the bell shows in the tray and the history entry has a Restore button
